Original MIT fixtures generated by `scripts/step-fixtures.py` through QA-only native OCCT 7.9.3 (cadquery-ocp-novtk 7.9.3.1.1), independently of the product Wasm exporter. No third-party model files are redistributed. The manifest records analytical dimensions, placements, volumes and file units. The open shell must be rejected. Headers contain fixed non-personal timestamps. Regeneration requires `scripts/qa-step-requirements.txt`. `scripts/verify-step.py` independently reads Engineer exports and checks SHA256, validity, volume, area, mass center, bounds and solid count. The QA wrapper is not shipped in the product.
